title: Double Machine Learning of Continuous Treatment Effects with Additive Instrumental Variables
abstract: arXiv:2601.01471v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Estimating causal effects of continuous treatments is a common problem in practice, for example, in studying average dose-response functions. Classical analyses typically assume that all confounders are fully observed, whereas in real-world applications, unmeasured confounding often persists. In this article, we propose a novel framework for the identification of average dose-response functions using instrumental variables, thereby mitigating bias induced by unobserved confounders. We introduce the concept of a uniform regular weighting function and consider covering the treatment space with a finite collection of open sets. On each of these sets, such a weighting function exists, allowing us to identify the average dose-response function locally within the corresponding region. translated_title: 连续治疗效应与加性工具变量的双重机器学习估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.01471v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：估计连续治疗变量的因果效应是实践中的常见问题，例如研究平均剂量反应函数。经典分析通常假设所有混杂因素都被完全观测到，而在实际应用中，未观测混杂因素往往持续存在。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，利用工具变量来识别平均剂量反应函数，从而减轻由未观测混杂因素引起的偏差。我们引入了均匀正则加权函数的概念，并考虑用有限个开集覆盖治疗空间。在每个开集上，这样的加权函数存在，使我们能够在相应区域内局部识别平均剂量反应函数。在估计方面，我们提出了一种增强的逆概率加权得分，用于带有工具变量的连续治疗，并基于去偏机器学习方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用工具变量和去偏机器学习的新框架，通过局部覆盖治疗空间来识别连续治疗的平均剂量反应函数，从而有效缓解未观测混杂带来的偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework using instrumental variables and debiased machine learning to identify average dose-response functions for continuous treatments by locally covering the treatment space, effectively mitigating bias from unobserved confounders.
